items.reply: I retain TP/medium: the new SELECT/DELETE split returns RowsAffected, and xorm_store.go:656 stops cleanup when that value is zero despite potentially remaining eligible rows. The bulk deletion path can remove every fetched ID between those statements. The concurrent-insert comment does not establish that abandoning an existing cleanup backlog is harmless; this race delays enforcement of configured retention limits. Recovery on the next cycle limits the impact, but this remains incorrect behavior under uncommon concurrency, matching medium rather than a nit.
